design_principle: Hierarchical multi-agent operating network with deterministic routing, shared ACP language, validation gates, and scalable specialization.

layers.name: Human Intent
layers.role: business intent, request, constraints, desired outcome

layers.name: Global Orchestrator
layers.role: task decomposition, routing, state, dependency graph

layers.name: Evidence & Tool Agents
layers.role: web, documents, APIs, structured data, calculations

layers.name: Validation & Red Team
layers.role: constraint, evidence, contradiction, risk and adversarial checks

layers.name: Learning & Memory
layers.role: feedback, error learning, memory consolidation, routing optimization

layers.name: Final Gatekeeper
layers.role: release decision, output integrity, audit trail

communication_protocol.name: ACP-X
rules: Agents never depend on free-form hidden state between stages.
Every handoff carries a trace id.
Evidence is distinguishable from findings and assumptions.
Validation status is explicit and must be updated at gates.
Agents may request escalation instead of bypassing authority.
Only authorized layers may mutate shared state.
